response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), so RET-020 applies. At priority 90 it dominates the standard out-of-window rule RET-008 (priority 10). No final-sale or fraud-hold conditions are true, so RET-012 and RET-051 do not apply. Defective items may be returned regardless of the standard 30-day window, so despite 63 days since delivery, the return is eligible.
